notes.title: Archer Guardian update completed
notes.content:

　- New game rule：The game will be fail when player die. 
　- New monsters：Ratkin Spearman, Ratkin Elementalist, Evil Spirit. 
　- Add language support：Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese. 
　- Add steam achievements.
